hypothesis: Two defects in the labelBinding expression. The subordinate-clause alternation omitted the prepositions under and with, so a code clause introduced that way was not recognised as subordinate. More seriously, operator precedence bound the expression as (negation && firstAlternative) || rest, so the subordinate-clause negation only guarded the first alternative and the remaining alternatives could still set label binding. The alternation is now parenthesised as a whole.
